act.name: Indian Partnership Act, 1932
act.source_authority: Ministry of Corporate Affairs, Government of India
act.description: Central law governing partnership firms, partner duties and liabilities, registration and dissolution.

sections.title: Liability of a partner for acts of the firm.
sections.text: Section 25 concerns a partner's liability for acts of the firm; consult the linked official text for the complete provision.
sections.plain_language_summary: Partners can be jointly and severally liable for acts of the firm done while they are partners.
